profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a public cloud enterprise security provider founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Jose, California. The company describes itself as a leading provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation. Its unified cybersecurity platform, built on what it calls the Zero Trust Exchange, is designed to sit inline on every connection and restrict access so that users and entities can only reach what they are authorized to access.

The company offers Zscaler AI, a cloud security AI platform built on its Secure Service Edge infrastructure. According to its website, this platform addresses data loss prevention and AI traffic inspection. Zscaler's broader product suite spans AI asset management, attack surface management, data security, microsegmentation, VPN replacement, secure access for AI, threat exposure management, and security operations—all operating on a zero trust architecture.

Zscaler is a public company trading on NASDAQ under the ticker ZS (CIK 0001713683). The company faces legal exposure in California, with 220 cases held in the theworldofai.org database.
